regions.today: This afternoon will remain dry with a mix of cloud and warm spells of sunshine. Highest temperatures of 21 to 25 degrees, warmest in the southeast with light to moderate southwest breezes.
regions.tonight: Tonight will bring some patchy rain and drizzle. Many southern counties will remain fully dry. Some mist and hill fog too. Very mild and humid with overnight minima holding between 13 and 16 degrees in mostly light southwesterly breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Sunday will be mostly dry with a mix of cloud and warm spells of sunshine. Patchy drizzle will develop during the evening hours with a few sharp bursts possible. Top temperatures of 19 to 26 degrees, warmest for the Southeast, with moderate west to southwest breezes.
